author: Shikhar Jolly
description: Exploring AI, technology, product thinking, and the ideas shaping our world — explained without the technical headache.
aboutBody:
I'm Shikhar Jolly, a product management enthusiast and consultant who enjoys turning complex problems into clear, useful experiences.

At Deloitte, I work at the intersection of business and technology, translating customer journeys and business needs into product features, user stories, and requirements. I collaborate with product owners and technology teams from defining the problem through testing and go-live, with a particular interest in building smarter, more customer-centric products using AI and GenAI.

Before consulting, I worked in integration engineering at Maersk, delivering 40+ end-to-end B2B integration solutions and helping reduce manual data entry by 80%. My experience has shaped how I approach product problems: understand the underlying need, simplify the complexity, bring the right people together, and measure the impact.

**Idea Atlas** is my space to explore AI, product management, technology, and ideas worth unpacking. I write to make complicated concepts easier to understand, connect ideas across disciplines, and share what I'm learning along the way — without unnecessary jargon.
